OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized into
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When true, the create request is
            allowed even if another owner already has the same lastName and
            address; otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:

              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number

              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID

## Summary

The requirement: when more than 80 owners have already been created (registered) today, the owner response includes `bulkSignupWarning: true`; otherwise `false`.

The codebase is a Spring Boot REST app where the `Owner` response schema is defined in OpenAPI and all derived/presentation-only fields (`displayName`, `initials`, `membershipTier`, `locality`, etc.) are computed in `OwnerMapper` via MapStruct `@AfterMapping` hooks. I followed that same pattern:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean property to the `Owner` schema (not `OwnerFields`, so it stays output-only and doesn't affect create validation). The generated `OwnerDto` picks up the field automatically.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Converted the mapper from an `interface` to an abstract class so it can inject `OwnerRepository`, then added an `addBulkSignupWarning` `@AfterMapping` method. It counts owners whose `registrationDate` equals the current day — the same daily accumulation the existing per-day create-limit rule (`assertDailyCapacity`/`countOwnersRegisteredOn`) is based on — and sets the flag `true` when that count exceeds 80.

Because every read path (POST create response, GET by id, and list) flows through `OwnerMapper`, the flag is populated uniformly with no controller or service changes.
